case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment states there are eleven appellants.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment never states the accused's gender; 'Mixed' is not supported.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not stated.

accused_caste.quote: belong to Santhal community. They are tribals.
accused_caste.reason: Judgment describes the accused as Santhal tribals, not Scheduled Caste.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation is not stated; only poverty and economic weakness are described.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: They come from a very poor strata of the society
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Judgment describes the accused as poor tribals.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Jhore Soren is referred to as male (he, his).

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Same village/community; inimical relation over hen theft
accused_victim_relationship.quote: inimical relation between the deceased and accused family
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment never describes them as neighbours; it notes a community and family enmity.

offence_category.correct_value: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (charged as murder under s.302 r/w s.149)
offence_category.quote: convicted for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
offence_category.reason: Murder was the charge, but final conviction is culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.148; s.302 r/w s.149 (trial); s.304 Part II (final)
statutory_provisions.quote: Section 304 Part II of the IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.148 and the final conviction under s.304 Part II.

weapon.reason: Lathis and tangies are both mentioned; tangies were not used.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness testimony and medical (post-mortem) evidence are relied upon.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Victim tied and beaten by a group; fourteen injuries including rib fractures
aggravating_circumstances.quote: the appellants tied them with a rope against the bamboo pole and tree
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment describes tying, group assault and multiple injuries, so 'None noted' is inaccurate.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Poor tribal status; trivial trigger; about 14 years in jail
mitigating_circumstances.quote: this, in our view, is a case where justice must be tempered with mercy
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court expressly weighs socio-economic status, trivial cause and long custody as mitigating.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under s.148 and s.302 r/w s.149 as stated.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Affirmed the trial court's conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court affirmed the same.
high_court_outcome.reason: Judgment states the High Court affirmed the conviction and dismissed the appeal.

final_outcome.reason: Appellants were convicted, though the offence was modified to s.304 Part II.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court convicted for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

imprisonment_type.quote: sentencing them for the period already undergone by them
imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence is time already served, not a stated fixed term.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: Time already served of almost 14 years; no fixed term imposed
imprisonment_years.quote: the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years
imprisonment_years.reason: 14 years is custody already served, not a sentence imposed.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate and do not reveal the modified conviction outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Punishment range for s.302 is not stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Death was caused, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: doctor noticed fourteen injuries on the deceased. Most of them were bruises and abrasions
physical_harm.reason: Fourteen injuries, bruises, abrasions, rib fractures and scalp haematoma are all stated.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Eleven accused; charged under s.148 and s.302 r/w s.149; final conviction s.304 Part II
number_of_offences.reason: Eleven refers to accused, not offences; the s.304 Part II conviction is new, not upheld.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: A hen stolen from Bhagbat; penalty of one hen and two handies of liquor
financial_property_loss.quote: Appellant-Bhagbat's hen was stolen by deceased-Jhore Soren
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment mentions a stolen hen and penalty, so 'Not applicable' omits this property loss.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no common object to murder and sharp weapons were not used.

motive.quote: their anger and reaction to the theft of hen
motive.reason: Motive was anger over the hen theft and the panchayat penalty.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: PW-1, PW-3, PW-6, PW-7 testimony and PW-9 doctor's evidence are accurately summarised.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found related witnesses truthful with a ring of truth.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Accused's post-offence conduct is not stated; PW-7's fleeing is a witness matter.

custody_duration.quote: the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years
custody_duration.reason: Judgment states almost 14 years in jail.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 15/4/1989 (next day after 14/4/1989 incident); trial judgment date not stated; High Court judgment 20.01.2003; SC decision 5 February 2014
trial_duration.quote: On the next day, in the morning, deceased-Jhore Soren and PW-7 Kanka were called
trial_duration.reason: Offence date is the day after 14/4/1989; 20.01.2003 is the High Court judgment, not trial.

legal_representation.reason: Amicus and State counsel names match the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: Investigation completed; appellants charged; charge sheet not expressly mentioned
investigation_status.quote: upon completion of the investigation, the appellants came to be charged
investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet filing is not expressly stated, though investigation and charging are.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmance and SC modification to s.304 Part II match.

prosecution_argument.reason: State argued ocular evidence proved assault and common object to murder.

defence_argument.correct_value: Prosecution not proved beyond reasonable doubt; no intention to kill; injuries superficial and not vital; poor tribals long jailed
defence_argument.quote: the injuries are not on the vital part of the deceased's body. They are superficial in nature
defence_argument.reason: Amicus did not argue lack of individual role or trivial incident; focused on intention and injuries.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court relied on lack of common object, individual role and socio-economic context.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All listed precedents are cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.quote: justice must be tempered with mercy
sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale matches: ends of justice, background, trivial incident, time served.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Socio-economic status, tribal background, trivial incident and 14 years custody are all noted.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court identifies no aggravating factors and stresses mitigation.

other_sentence_order.quote: they are directed to be released forthwith unless they are otherwise required in any other case
other_sentence_order.reason: Sentence treated as undergone and release order match the judgment.
